sub_branches.concept: Foundational Principles & Key Narrative of 2.1 Atmosphere and Weather Elements
details: Weather reflects short-term atmospheric states in the troposphere (6-18 km high)
Temperature varies daily and seasonally
Thermometers measure ambient, maximum, and minimum temperatures
Liquid expansion (mercury/alcohol) or digital sensors record thermal states.
evidence_or_examples: Margin Glossary - Ambient & Statistics: Ambient means of immediate surroundings. Statistics is gathering/analysing data to detect patterns and make predictions.

sub_branches.concept: Foundational Principles & Key Narrative of 2.2 Atmospheric Pressure, Humidity & Rain Gauge
details: Air has weight and exerts pressure
Pressure is highest at sea level and decreases with altitude
Warm air expands and rises (low pressure), while cold air sinks (high pressure)
Rain gauges collect precipitation in open grounds away from obstructions to measure rainfall in millimeters.
evidence_or_examples: Did You Know? - Pine Cones & Natural Weather Signals: Pine cones close in humid conditions to protect seeds and open in dry weather. Ants move eggs higher before heavy rain; frogs croak prior to showers.

sub_branches.concept: To select an optimal site for placing a rain gauge to record accurate rainfall measurements.
details: Evaluate candidate sites: garden, terrace, open ground, wall, verandah.
Select an open ground on an elevated platform away from trees, tall walls, or overhangs.
Ensure rainwater enters directly without obstruction or splash runoff from nearby structures.
evidence_or_examples: Observations: Open ground placement avoids roof drip or wall shelter errors, yielding true precipitation depth.
Conclusion: Open ground placement avoids roof drip or wall shelter errors, yielding true precipitation depth.

sub_branches.concept: Competency Scenario Analysis: A student in Jammu records the following data: Temp Max 25.8...
details: Q: Calculate the diurnal temperature range. -> A: 25.8°C - 5.6°C = 20.2°C.
Q: What weather condition is indicated by 93% humidity combined with low morning temp? -> A: High saturation of air with moisture, leading to fog, mist, or rain showers.
evidence_or_examples: A student in Jammu records the following data: Temp Max 25.8°C, Temp Min 5.6°C, Humidity 93%, Heavy rainfall recorded overnight.

sub_branches.concept: Comprehensive Synthesis: Differentiate between maximum-minimum thermometers and digital thermometers. Explain how statistics helps IMD in weather forecasting.
details: Maximum-minimum thermometers record the highest and lowest temperatures in a 24-hour cycle using liquid expansion, whereas digital thermometers use electronic sensors providing real-time precise digital readouts. Statistics allows the IMD to collect historical temperature, pressure, and rainfall data, analyze trends, detect atmospheric patterns, and issue accurate weather forecasts and disaster alerts.
